description: A JavaScript module providing an API client for a weather dashboard, including functions to fetch weather data (with mock support), normalize payloads, and handle environment configuration.

methods.name: getFeatureFlags
methods.description: Parses feature flags from environment variable REACT_APP_FEATURE_FLAGS, returning an object with boolean flags.

methods.name: fetchWeather
methods.description: Fetches weather data for a given query (city or 'lat,lon'), supports mock mode, and normalizes the response payload.

methods.name: fetchWeatherByCoords
methods.description: Fetches weather data using latitude and longitude, supports mock mode, and normalizes the response payload.

methods.name: doFetchAndNormalize
methods.description: Performs fetch request with timeout, handles errors, and normalizes the weather payload.

methods.name: normalizeWeatherPayload
methods.description: Maps various possible backend response shapes to a normalized weather data structure.

methods.name: mockWeather
methods.description: Generates deterministic mock weather data based on a query string.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Creates a hash code from a string, used for deterministic mock data generation.
